item.title: Buruku primary to rebuild after years of structural risk
item.description: Buruku Adventist Primary School in Western Province was one of the schools affected by the devastating 8.3-magnitude earthquake that struck the province in 2007. The earthquake severely damaged the school’s building, shaking its foundation and placing students at serious risk.
